parsed.name: UDP组播CAN虚拟总线
parsed.description: 用于实验软件中的非物理虚拟通信组件，通过 IP/UDP 组播在多个进程或主机之间传输 CAN 或 CAN-FD 报文。适合局域网内的分布式测试、仿真和进程间总线消息交换，不对应具体硬件仪器。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical virtual communication component used in lab software to exchange CAN or CAN-FD messages between multiple processes or hosts over IP/UDP multicast. It is suited for distributed testing, simulation, and inter-process bus messaging on a LAN, and does not correspond to a specific hardware instrument.

actions.description: 检查是否支持 CAN-FD 帧。

actions.description: 通过 UDP 组播虚拟总线发送 CAN 或 CAN-FD 报文。
actions.description_en: Send a CAN or CAN-FD message over the UDP multicast virtual bus.
